lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 5-6 discernible vertical columns of high-luminance circular blobs arranged in a grid-like pattern posterior to the branchial region, primarily situated between the lateral carinae.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical linear features of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal carinae to form anchor nodes for the primary high-luminance blobs.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible along the lateral flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with high-intensity highlights on the superior edge and high-value shadows on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A series of high-intensity, smaller circular blobs are visible along the proximal and medial surfaces of the primary pectoral fin.
